title: Boss: Contact Book Page
summary: Rendering, escaping, events, form validation and storage, all as testable pure functions.

steps.title: The job
steps.body: A contact book page has three moving parts: render the list, handle clicks on it (delegation), and add contacts from a form, saved in storage. The page's glue code would be a few lines of `addEventListener`; you write the logic it calls. Paste your finished functions into the Playground's HTML/CSS/JS tab afterwards and wire them to a real page.

steps.title: Render contacts
prompt: - `type Contact = { id: number; name: string; email: string; favorite: boolean }`
- Show only contacts whose name or email contains `filter` (case-insensitive, trimmed).

- Each contact: `
  • name email
    • ` where the star is `★` for favourites and `☆` otherwise. Escape name and email.

- Wrap in `
    ...
`. With no matches, return `

No contacts

`.

steps.title: Handle a list click
prompt: Write `onListClick(contacts, click)` that returns the **new** contacts array for a delegated click. `click` is `{ action?: string; id?: string }`, the `data-action` of the clicked button and the `data-id` of its `li` (either may be missing if the click landed elsewhere).
- anything else (or a missing/unknown id) returns the **same array** unchanged (so the page can skip re-rendering)
starter: type Contact = { id: number; name: string; email: string; favorite: boolean };
function onListClick(contacts: Contact[], click: { action?: string; id?: string }): Contact[] {
solution: type Contact = { id: number; name: string; email: string; favorite: boolean };
function onListClick(contacts: Contact[], click: { action?: string; id?: string }): Contact[] {
if (click.action === "fav") return contacts.map(c => (c.id === id ? { ...c, favorite: !c.favorite } : c));
template: {{CODE}}
const dojoC = [
{ id: 1, name: "Zed", email: "z@x.io", favorite: false },
{ id: 2, name: "Bo", email: "bo@x.io", favorite: true },
Dojo.eq("fav toggles", [true, true], onListClick(dojoC, { action: "fav", id: "1" }).map(c => c.favorite));
Dojo.eq("original untouched", false, dojoC[0].favorite);
Dojo.eq("delete removes", [1], onListClick(dojoC, { action: "delete", id: "2" }).map(c => c.id));
Dojo.check("unknown action returns the same array", onListClick(dojoC, { action: "edit", id: "1" }) === dojoC, "expected the very same array back");
Dojo.check("missing id returns the same array", onListClick(dojoC, { action: "delete" }) === dojoC, "expected the very same array back");
Dojo.check("unknown id returns the same array", onListClick(dojoC, { action: "fav", id: "99" }) === dojoC, "expected the very same array back");
hints: `map` with a spread for fav, `filter` for delete.

steps.title: Add from the form and persist
prompt: 1. Load contacts from storage key `"contacts"` (missing or broken JSON means `[]`).

2. Validate `form` (`Record<string, string>`): `name` required after trim; `email` must contain `@`; and no existing contact may have the same email (case-insensitive). Error messages: `"name"`, `"email"`, `"duplicate"`.

3. If valid, add `{ id, name, email, favorite: false }` with `id` one more than the largest existing id (1 for the first), save the whole list back as JSON, and return `{ ok: true, contacts }`. Otherwise return `{ ok: false, errors }` and save nothing.

type StorageLike = { getItem(k: string): string | null; setItem(k: string, v: string): void };
function addContact(storage: StorageLike, form: Record<string, string>) {
if (errors.length) return { ok: false as const, errors };
const id = contacts.reduce((max, c) => Math.max(max, c.id), 0) + 1;
const next = [...contacts, { id, name, email, favorite: false }];
return { ok: true as const, contacts: next };
template: {{CODE}}
const dojoM = new Map<string, string>();
const dojoS = { getItem: (k: string) => dojoM.get(k) ?? null, setItem: (k: string, v: string) => { dojoM.set(k, v); } };
Dojo.eq("first contact", { ok: true, contacts: [{ id: 1, name: "Ada", email: "ada@x.io", favorite: false }] }, addContact(dojoS, { name: " Ada ", email: "ada@x.io" }));
Dojo.eq("saved to storage", [{ id: 1, name: "Ada", email: "ada@x.io", favorite: false }], JSON.parse(dojoM.get("contacts") ?? "null"));
Dojo.eq("duplicate email", { ok: false, errors: ["duplicate"] }, addContact(dojoS, { name: "Other", email: "ADA@x.io" }));
Dojo.eq("invalid", { ok: false, errors: ["name", "email"] }, addContact(dojoS, { name: "", email: "nope" }));
dojoM.set("contacts", JSON.stringify([{ id: 7, name: "Bo", email: "bo@x.io", favorite: true }]));
Dojo.eq("next id after the largest", 8, (addContact(dojoS, { name: "Cy", email: "cy@x.io" }) as any).contacts?.[1]?.id);
dojoM.set("contacts", "{oops");
Dojo.eq("broken storage starts fresh", 1, (addContact(dojoS, { name: "Di", email: "di@x.io" }) as any).contacts?.length);
hints: Write a small `load(storage)` helper with try/catch.
`contacts.reduce((max, c) => Math.max(max, c.id), 0) + 1` gives the next id.
